Return population data stored by package

Source: R/package_data.R
package_cohort.Rd

Return population data stored by package

Usage

package_cohort(country, year)

Arguments

country

[string]

The name of a country (for which data is available & stored in the package). Case-sensitive. Please use function hrqol_norms to see the list of permissible country names.

year

[integer]

A year (for which data is available & stored in the package).

Value

A data frame, containing population data for the chosen country and year.

Examples

package_cohort(country = "Romania", year = 2022)
